scope: Explicit navigation from application/data clauses to scoped implementation and test evidence. No mapping certifies every sentence or a production release.

mappings.scope: Filename identities, bounded metadata/audit publication, duplicate detection, directory refresh and source revisions. Windows sharing/access retries preserve the prior atomic catalog and propagate persistent failures. The real archive audit is bounded; unknown metadata is not certified.
Separate validated mirror publication and raw-hash/mapping invalidation. Optional mirrors do not alter source archives.

Explicit conservative simulation profiles and component defaults. Exact historical broker rules, account parity, adjusted deliverables, portfolio margin and unsupported permissions remain distinct limitations.

Causal canonicalization, immutable quote/trade records, explicit units, temporal indices, corrections and known-as-of references. Real archive IV units and deliverable evidence remain runtime inputs; ambiguous units do not become supported P50 inputs.

Calendar scenarios and explicit session overrides, distinct option stop/fixing/replay boundaries, missing-slot handling and deterministic valid-prefix advances. Scenario schedules are not exchange-certified historical records.

Synchronized Qt models, typed sorting, stale selection/state gating, queued inference, deduplicated requests, archive ACK retention and orderly shutdown. Screen-bound native frames, restored oversized layouts and scroll-reachable ticket/portfolio controls have explicit tests. These tests do not certify every display-scale or performance release gate.

Visible-only chart chunks, causal aggregation, bounded reads and immutable byte-budget caches. Selected-session latency measurements do not establish full-archive p95 or child-process peak-memory acceptance.

Spawned isolated inference, worker restart, immutable manifest revision checks, bounded reference work and canceled-request archival. Full supported numerical query resource qualification remains a separate gate.

Transactional economic history and immutable analytic inputs/results, pending/null reasons, exact archive identity across branches/copied sessions and unchanged economic versions. Initial benchmark inputs are committed with their campaign transaction. Source/lock/runtime identities are frozen and checked before restore; incompatible schema-v1 sessions retain a tested read-only raw export path without semantic migration.

Pinned development environment, deployment configuration and executed local smoke evidence. A separate clean Windows account without the build environment and the final packaged-source revision require their own recorded acceptance.
Local timing, poisoning, calendar, fee, account, lifecycle, idempotency and UI fixture families. Mapping these files does not assert every A-O clause is independently accepted.

Source-runtime Windows captures verify effective DPR1/1.5/2, native frame containment, scroll-reachable submission and ticket/account/risk/closed-state panels. Final compiled evidence remains separate. Unqualified-model abstention latency is not supported-probability latency, and developer-account checks/native-verifier refusal are not clean-account certification.
Consult the per-DT scoped tests and limitations in the data report. Source-shaped synthetic tests and a bounded real audit do not establish complete archive qualification.
Event-phase boundaries, late/minute availability and equivalence of large versus small committed advances.
Money/quantity signs, unit provenance, exact identities and null reasons are distributed across these contracts; each clause requires its own scoped verification.
Concrete economic and workflow example families. A source/example mapping is not an independent pass of all numerical and lifecycle prerequisites.
Precedence, decisions and runtime-input declarations. Historical metadata and production qualification remain explicit; no file link is treated as resolution of an external-input or numerical gate.

Risk reports distinguish implemented mechanics, scoped tests, conditional legacy features and incomplete numerical/production qualification. This mapping does not turn all mathematical tests into failures merely because a production pack is unavailable.
